$doc: Vyomi capability registry — GCP Marketplace and Cloud Hub (Vyomi's own aggregate surfaces). See aws/s3.json for the contract. Feature ids are prefixed gcp.hub.*

gcp.hub.marketplace.title: Marketplace (catalog, subscribe, cancel)
limitations: The catalog is Vyomi's SaaS-simulator 'spaces' (the same catalog as the AWS Marketplace page), not Google's Marketplace listings; subscribing creates a live space with an endpoint and API key and cancelling removes it. The page uses Vyomi's own /vyomi/gcp/{project}/marketplace wire because Google has no public API for the console page. There is no billing, EULA text or vendor onboarding.

gcp.hub.cloud-hub.title: Cloud Hub (resource counts per product, open incidents, recent admin activity)
limitations: Everything is derived live from the project's real Vyomi resources and the Admin Activity audit log (Vyomi's own /vyomi/gcp/{project}/hub wire; Google has no public API for the console page). Service health, optimization and cost panels of the real Cloud Hub are not modelled.
